claims.text: The driver-device trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a). It carries a single 428.0 s dropout between the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix — more than four times the 90 s limb — against a 10 s nominal sample interval. I disclose the impairment: EV-GPS-00110 sits at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, and the rider does not tender it as clean evidence.

The dropout is not peripheral. It spans 6.90 km in a straight line between the two KPE portals and, on the assessor's own note, covers the entire segment the rider disputes. Over the one stretch where the alleged excess arises, the trace measures nothing at all.

No independent source corroborates a deviation, as POL-RD-07(ii) requires. The chat log holds no driver admission — the only driver message is 'going KPE ah boss' — and the export is truncated 2186 s before trip end (issue TRUNCATED_LOG, weight 0.60). The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so no gantry places the vehicle off the optimal corridor, and its distance_charged_km of 21.20 is an identical copy of the trace figure rather than an independent measurement (issue PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.75). The trip record's actual_distance_km is itself derived from the impaired trace, as its own admissibility note states. Each of the four sources POL-RD-07(ii) names is therefore absent or derivative.

The driver's own account does not supply the corroboration either. His statement is that he took the KPE 'like always' — the very corridor the booked optimal route traverses, KPE then ECP — so it is not a statement admitting a route the optimal route does not use, and it cannot be converted into the POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration the rider needs. The surviving chat export, which is impaired (issue TRUNCATED_LOG, weight 0.60), says the same thing and no more.

The driver cannot carry an exoneration under POL-RD-03. No traffic advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19–19:02 window on 22 July 2026: EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, and that absence is itself citable. A bare assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the driver's burden under POL-RD-08.

The bundle cannot separate the two possible readings of the disputed stretch. Read the POL-RD-07(i) way — a straight line across the gap, the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip is 21.20 km and under the POL-RD-01 threshold; a surface route between the same two portals is 25.50 km and over it. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes them. POL-RD-07(i) obliges the driver-favourable reading, so the excess cannot be carried above the POL-RD-01 threshold on this trace — but that is an unresolved indeterminacy on the disputed stretch, not a finding that the driver drove the optimal route.

The consequence is fixed by the policy, not by discretion. Where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists, POL-RD-07(iii) directs that the claim is not sustained on the present record and that the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because absence of proof here is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes the same escalation mandatory.

Independently, the distance fact that decides this case is carried solely by EV-GPS-00110 at weight 0.39. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the ruling's confidence cannot exceed the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact, so it cannot exceed 0.39 — below the 0.70 platform floor — and POL-RD-10(1) requires escalation on that ground as well. The issue codes on EV-GPS-00110 are GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and discharges limb (a): trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00110 with consistent pickup timing. Limb (b) cannot be met from an unimpaired trace and no independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii) exists, so the burden does not shift to the driver. POL-RD-08's own remedy set includes ESCALATE, which is the outcome this record supports.

The stakes for the rider are concrete. The fare ledger shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the $34.42 charged — including the $10.00 the rider contests — stands against the rider today. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION preserves exactly that state, whereas ESCALATE holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it. An escalation is the only outcome this record supports that does not leave the charge on the rider.

claims.text: The rider's claim fails the POL-RD-01 threshold test on this trip's own numbers. Excess = actual_distance_km less optimal_distance_km = 21.20 - 18.40 = 2.80 km, which is 2.80 / 18.40 = 15.2% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be BOTH greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms; both tests must pass. 15.2% fails the percentage limb, so no deviation is ESTABLISHED and the clause directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. Disclosure: the governing actual figure comes from EV-GPS-00110, which is IMPAIRED (issues GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39); that impairment is addressed under POL-RD-07 below and does not supply the rider with a deviation.

POL-RD-07(i) dictates how the impaired stretch is measured: the excess across the gap is taken as the straight line between the bounding fixes, which the clause itself calls the reading most favourable to the driver. The single gap is 428.0 s against an expected interval of 10.0 s, bridged by a 6.90 km straight line, and on that prescribed basis the whole trip traces 21.20 km - so the excess remains 2.80 km and 15.2% and no POL-RD-01 threshold is crossed. The policy's own answer to the tunnel dropout therefore yields no deviation at all, which is the outcome most favourable to the driver and the one the clause commands. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED, issues GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39.

The rider also fails the initial burden POL-RD-08 places on them. POL-RD-08(b) requires an excess measured either from an unimpaired gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii). EV-GPS-00110 carries a 428.0 s gap, far over the 90 s limb, so it is impaired for policy purposes, and no independent source names any excess: EV-FARE-00110's distance_charged_km of 21.20 km is identical to the trace figure, and POL-RD-07(ii) says in terms that billed distance is NOT independent corroboration where it is a copy of the trace figure; EV-CHAT-00110 contains no driver admission; the driver's counterparty_statement asserts the KPE rather than a detour; and EV-TRIP-00110's actual_distance_km is itself derived from the impaired trace. With no independent source, the rider's assertion - which cites no evidence ID - is not sustained. Disclosure: EV-FARE-00110 is IMPAIRED (PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.75) and EV-CHAT-00110 is IMPAIRED (TRUNCATED_LOG, weight_multiplier 0.6).

Nothing in the bundle shows the driver leaving the optimal corridor. EV-TRIP-00110 records the optimal route as 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries'; the driver's in-app message at 18:25:50 is 'going KPE ah boss'; and his counterparty_statement is 'I took the KPE like always'. The only route evidence on file therefore places the vehicle on the very corridor the platform computed as optimal, and the rider's reply of 'ok' at 18:26:14 shows the road was communicated before the disputed segment was reached. Disclosure: EV-CHAT-00110 is IMPAIRED, issue TRUNCATED_LOG, weight_multiplier 0.6 - the export stops at 18:26:14 - so I put this point no higher than the surviving log supports.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern to weigh against the driver. Under POL-RD-06 a pattern is established only where driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more, or where deviation_flags_90d divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 0.05 or more with completed_trips_90d of at least 40. On EV-DPROF-00110 those figures are 0 and 744 - a ratio of 0.000 - so neither limb is met. No balance in the evidence may therefore be resolved against the driver and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. I cite only the two fields POL-RD-06 names; every other profile field is context only under POL-GEN-01.

The rider's timing complaint is not a test the policy runs. The rider contrasts 39 minutes against 6.30pm traffic, but POL-RD-01's deviation test is exclusively a distance test - actual against optimal, both measured in kilometres, with no duration limb at all. EV-TRIP-00110 shows the platform's own optimal route at 26.0 minutes for 18.4 km, so the rider's 'the timing does not make sense' point does not touch the threshold that decides this case.

The $3.00 toll line the rider also contests is a pass-through of gantries on the optimal route, not a deviation charge. EV-TRIP-00110 records optimal_route_erp_sgd of 3.00 for a route that crosses both gantries, and EV-FARE-00110 charges tolls_erp of 3.00 at metered cost, with a surge_multiplier of 1.0 so no uplift is applied. The POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction is not engaged: the gantry itemisation is absent from the ledger rather than contradicted, and where a gantry cannot be matched for want of coordinates the clause treats the line as matched. Disclosure: EV-FARE-00110 is IMPAIRED, issue PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.75.

In the alternative, if the judge finds the tunnel gap cannot be resolved even on the POL-RD-07(i) straight-line basis, that is a data failure and not a finding for the rider. Under POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) the case would ESCALATE, and POL-GEN-03 makes escalation terminal: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is HELD rather than collected or refunded. The rider therefore recovers nothing on that path either, and the driver should not carry the cost of a signal dropout that the trace itself brackets between two fixes on his own corridor. Disclosure: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED, issues GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this case is escalated to a human reviewer under POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3). Escalation is terminal — no refund issues, no charge is collected or refunded, and the disputed $10.00 is held.

THE DISTANCE QUESTION CANNOT BE DECIDED ON THIS RECORD. EV-GPS-00110 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): a single 428-second dropout — more than four times the 90-second limb — between the Defu Flyover and Kallang KPE portal fixes, against a 10-second sample interval. The admissibility report records that the gap covers the whole stretch the rider disputes. The trace carries weight 0.39 (issues GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) and it is the only artifact actually carrying the distance: EV-TRIP-00110's actual_distance_km and EV-FARE-00110's distance_charged_km are both copies of the same figure.

POL-RD-01 numbers: actual 21.20 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which governs) against optimal 18.40 km (EV-TRIP-00110), an excess of 2.80 km = 15.2%, below the 20% establishment test. The driver is right that on the driver-favourable straight-line reading POL-RD-07(i) prescribes across the gap, no deviation is established and POL-RD-01 would otherwise produce NO_ACTION. But POL-RD-07(i) fixes how the unobserved stretch is measured; it does not decide whether the driver drove it, and a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km and over the threshold. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two.
